correctness.rationale: Work with A:U→V and e_i:V→U. The projections E_i=e_iA on U and F_i=Ae_i on V commute within each family. A intertwines these families, and each e_i is also an intertwiner in the reverse direction. On an active signature σ, take i with σ_i=1: A and e_i are inverse isomorphisms on the joint spaces, and each e_j there is σ_j times A inverse. On the zero signature each e_j vanishes. On im A the joint eigenspaces W_σ form an ordered direct-sum decomposition, counted by the stated GL quotient. The active spaces in U are independent sections of A over W_σ, contributing q^((m-r)D); the zero space is A^{-1}(W_0). The active spaces in V are the W_σ themselves; the zero space modulo W_0 is a complement to W_active in V/W_0, contributing q^((n-r)D). These choices construct all tuples without overcount. A matrix Y centralizes the tuple exactly when E_iY=YF_i for all i, hence is an unrestricted diagonal family of maps between equal signatures. The active square algebra factors use invertible A, and the residual rectangular factor uses A of rank d_0. Ordinary ranks add, with rank-j rectangular maps counted by the full-rank two-factor count divided by |GL_j|. This proves the stated polynomials including all-zero tuples, r=0, zero-size factors, ordered repetitions and arbitrary characteristic. The claimed independence means fixing the active multiplicities; the literal full type includes d_0 and determines r. Fresh bounded corroboration: python3 /workspace/reproductions/trace_and_commutant.py gives 113 triples over F_4 at m=n=2 and a non-diagonal rank-one A: the zero type occurs once and each active bit pattern 16 times, with active commutant coefficients (1,6,9) and zero-type coefficients (1,75,180). The frozen checker was inspected, not run.
residual_risks: Finite corroboration does not prove arbitrary parameters; that rests on the simultaneous decomposition.

value.rationale: This yields the full rank distribution of the commutant of each tuple, not just the number of compatible idempotents. It resolves which data control the distribution: active signatures matter even at the same marginal ranks (the displayed 32 versus 8 example), whereas changes in the residual sandwich rank do not affect the ordinary-rank polynomial. This is a useful uniform invariant for studying the common commutants of these nonunital matrix algebras.
residual_risks: No claim for defining tuples of nonidempotents or for an invariant that recovers residual multiplication.
